title: card.wireless Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Response containing wireless connection status, signal quality information, and detailed modem/network data from the Notecard.

count.description: Number of bars of signal quality.

net.description: An object with detailed modem, radio access technology, and signal information (details will differ depending on the type of Notecard).

iccid.description: Integrated Circuit Card Identifier of the SIM card.

modem.description: Modem firmware version and model information.

band.description: The frequency band being used for communication.

ratr.description: The Radio Access Technology the modem reports for its current network connection (for example, LTE, eMTC, or NB-IoT).

ratf.description: The Radio Access Technology the Notecard targets when it registers with a network: `M1`, `NB1`, `GSM`, or `LTE`.

carrier.description: The name of the carrier reported by the modem.

internal.description: `true` if the Notecard is using its internal SIM. Omitted when the Notecard is using an external SIM.

rssir.description: An approximate Received Signal Strength Indicator, in dBm, reported by the modem.

sinr.description: Signal to Interference plus Noise Ratio.

bars.description: Signal strength represented as bars (0–4 on cellular, 0–5 on WiFi).

updated.description: Unix timestamp of when the network information was last updated.

status.description: The current status of the wireless connection and modem.

samples.title: Complete Wireless Status Response
samples.description: Example response showing comprehensive wireless connection and signal information.

samples.title: Basic Signal Information
samples.description: Example response with basic signal strength and status.

samples.title: Network Details Response
samples.description: Example response showing detailed network information.
